decisions_made.decision: Live problem bank lives on the Fly persistent volume (/data/problems), seeded once from the image
decisions_made.rationale: Scale-to-zero wipes the ephemeral fs; a baked-only bank reverts on cold start so Syncs never stick

decisions_made.decision: Stub main() only does I/O and calls a named solution function; enforced by audit.py
decisions_made.rationale: A batch regressed to solving inside main(); mirrors real OA/LC harness; now a hard gate

decisions_made.decision: Test quality is mandatory: >=5 curated edges incl. a max-scale case, and every reference is brute-force cross-checked
decisions_made.rationale: Weak suites let a wrong/slow solution pass; audit warns below 5

decisions_made.decision: Presence is best-effort with no heartbeat (last_seen bumped by real traffic only)
decisions_made.rationale: A background heartbeat would keep the scale-to-zero machine awake and cost money

decisions_made.decision: Delegate the scraper only to Grok (cursor-agent), scoped to oa-scraper; author judged packages in Claude
decisions_made.rationale: Bulk scraping fits delegation; authoring/verification stays with Claude; the app is never touched, verified via git HEAD checks

decisions_made.decision: Skip OA problems whose provided solution contradicts their own samples (e.g. #8 Square Tile)
decisions_made.rationale: Cannot ship a guessed judge; verification discipline over coverage
